notes: weight is the CN pick rate (sums to ~10 per game across all champions).
hp/armor/mr are level-18 base stats from game.gtimg.cn plus an estimated late-game item package by role (see role_items) and ~300 HP from augments.
cc is Tencent's 1-3 crowd-control rating; phys_share comes from the champion's damage type.
damage_share and damage_taken_share are the champion's average share of their team's damage dealt and taken.
